title: antirrhinum sempervirens subsp. microphyllum
intro: Antirrhinum sempervirens subsp. microphyllum, commonly known as the dwarf snapdragon, is a plant species that belongs to the family Plantaginaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from anxiety, insomnia, and inflammation due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Antirrhinum sempervirens subsp. microphyllum include its sedative, anti-inflammatory, and spasmolytic effects, making it useful in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, glycosides, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
